title: Large-format advertising
slide_intent: Use type with imagery at urban scale because a message must be read amid competing surroundings.
strategic_value: Consistent lettering across differently colored campaigns can retain Lufthansa recognition while varying the destination story.
demonstration: Two adjoining building wraps carry large white German headlines, photographic backgrounds and small Lufthansa signatures.
practical_value: Compare headline visibility and signature placement across adjacent outdoor executions.
